PsAbortOnFailure: Abort remaining actions on non-zero exit
CtSkipIfExists: Skip if an open ticket with the same title already exists
HttpAllowLocalTargetsHint: SSRF guard: without this, requests to loopback and link-local addresses (incl. cloud metadata) are refused
PsCoalesceOverlappingHint: For idempotent scripts that scan global state: only one copy runs at a time for this automation
ActionTypeHelp: The deterministic operation KittyClaw executes. In a column processor, the agent call and routing remain separate single steps.
LabelsToAddHelp: Names added to the current ticket. KittyClaw creates unknown labels and preserves existing ones.
LabelsToRemoveHelp: Names removed from the current ticket. Unknown names are ignored.
CommentContentHelp: Text added to the current ticket. Available variables: {ticketId}, {ticketTitle}, {ticketStatus}, {assignee}, {outcome}, and {summary}.
CommentAuthorHelp: Name displayed as the comment author. Leave empty in a processor to use the processor name.
CtTitleHelp: Title of the new ticket. Supports date variables and current-ticket variables.
CtDescriptionHelp: Description of the new ticket. The same variables as the title are resolved at execution time.
CtStatusHelp: Initial column of the created ticket, resolved within the current ticket's pipeline.
CtPriorityHelp: Priority assigned when the ticket is created.
CtLabelsHelp: Labels added to the new ticket after creation.
CtCreatedByHelp: Author stored in the creation activity. When empty, KittyClaw uses the processor name.
PsScriptHelp: Inline PowerShell executed in the project workspace. It is ignored when a script file is set.
PsScriptFileHelp: Path to a .ps1 file, relative to the workspace or absolute. It replaces the inline script.
PsArgumentsHelp: Arguments passed separately to the script. Ticket and agent-result variables are resolved in each one.
PsTimeoutHelp: Maximum execution time. On expiry, KittyClaw stops the process tree and fails the action.
HttpMethodHelp: HTTP method used for the outbound request.
HttpUrlHelp: Target HTTP(S) URL. Ticket and agent-result variables are resolved before the call.
HttpBodyHelp: Optional request body. Variables are resolved before it is sent.
HttpContentTypeHelp: MIME type sent with the body, for example application/json.
HttpTimeoutHelp: Maximum request duration. A timeout is handled as an action failure.
